# Assam Wild Safari (Manas Holidays)

> Kaziranga and Manas jungle safari booking, North East India tour packages and airport pickup & drop in Assam, India. Based in Abhayapuri, Assam. Phone / WhatsApp: +91 93656 09948, +91 97098 84206.

Assam Wild Safari lets travellers request jeep safaris in Kaziranga National Park and Manas National Park (both UNESCO World Heritage Sites in Assam), book ready-made North East India itineraries, and arrange fixed-fare pickup and drop between Guwahati / Bongaigaon / Barpeta Road and the parks. Safari requests are checked for availability first; a secure payment link is then sent on WhatsApp.

## Main pages
- [Kaziranga jeep safari booking, rates & timings](https://assamkaziranganationalpark.com/kaziranga-jungle-safari/): private jeep from ₹3,600 per jeep; shared seat ₹1,000 per person (Indian), ₹1,700 (foreigner)
- [Manas National Park jeep safari booking, rates & zones](https://assamkaziranganationalpark.com/manas-jungle-safari/): private jeep from ₹5,500 per jeep; shared seat ₹1,500 per person (Indian), ₹2,200 (foreigner); Manas camera fees apply
- [North East India tour packages](https://assamkaziranganationalpark.com/north-east-india-tour-packages/): 7 itineraries
- [Guwahati airport to Kaziranga & Manas taxi fares](https://assamkaziranganationalpark.com/guwahati-to-kaziranga-manas-taxi/): fixed fares per vehicle, one way
- [Book a safari](https://assamkaziranganationalpark.com/pages/booking.html)
- [Car rental and customised routes](https://assamkaziranganationalpark.com/pages/car-rental.html)
- [Guest reviews](https://assamkaziranganationalpark.com/pages/reviews.html)

- [Guwahati, Shillong, Dawki, Cherrapunji & Kaziranga](https://assamkaziranganationalpark.com/north-east-india-tour-packages/guwahati-shillong-dawki-cherrapunji-and-kaziranga/) — 6 Nights / 7 Days
